summary: Block 15, source-only. Repaired the four reported BinderAudit defects and four further comparator defects into a self-contained supplementary packet. Lean side v2 now imports both OAI modules (targets no longer absent), builds names at runtime from strings so a miss reaches MISSING instead of aborting at parse time, replaces the non-existent ci.ctorName with an explicit match over ConstantInfo, wraps each target in try/catch, and flattens every type to one line. Comparator now checks definitions as well as theorems, rejects unknown extra instances and missing required ones, fails closed on absent declarations and ERROR lines, separates strictImplicit from explicit, verifies the type binders and the exact explicit sequence and a total binder count of 31, and honours per-declaration forbidden lists -- a real bug found while testing (the definitions legitimately retain the two Y instances). Exercised only on SYNTHETIC captures: faithful -> fails=0; forbidden plus PolishSpace Y -> flagged and FAIL; MISSING and ERROR -> fail closed. That validates the comparator, not the tree. Accepted evidence unchanged: textual hypotheses + defeq + compatibility (R5). Binder identity not claimed. No new bound.
verified_results: GRADE [C] BinderAudit.lean v2 is self-contained: it imports OAI.Analysis.PlaneSpectrum.ConditionalSpectrum and OAI.MeasureTheory.CompactFactors.ConditionalLimits, so the six targets are resolvable; the block-14 version imported only Lean and would have printed MISSING for all of them.

GRADE [C] Robust target naming: names are built at runtime by mkName from plain strings; there are no double-backtick quotations, so a wrong or absent name reaches the find? none branch and prints MISSING instead of aborting the file during elaboration.

GRADE [C] ci.ctorName removed: kindOf matches all eight ConstantInfo constructors explicitly. Each target is wrapped in try/catch, printing ERROR <fqn> <message> and continuing, so one failure cannot suppress the others.
GRADE [C] Every printed type is flattened to one line, so a multi-line pretty-print cannot split a binder across records.

GRADE [C] Comparator checks all five declarations (2 theorems + 3 definitions), verifies each instance binder's normalised type against instance_allowed, rejects any unseen instance as UNKNOWN EXTRA INSTANCE, requires every allowed instance present, fails closed on an absent declaration or an ERROR line, counts strictImplicit separately and fails on it, pins the implicit Type binders to X,Y,W (plus Z for EncodingApproximationAt, a value binder of type Type), pins the 20-name explicit sequence, and asserts expected_total_binders = 31 for both theorems.

GRADE [C] Real bug found and fixed while testing v2: the first version applied the theorems' forbidden-instance list to the definitions, which legitimately retain StandardBorelSpace Y and Nonempty Y. instance_forbidden is now read per declaration.

GRADE [C] COMPARATOR EXERCISED ON SYNTHETIC CAPTURES ONLY: a faithful 31-binder capture of both theorems and all three definitions gives SUMMARY fails=0; a capture carrying StandardBorelSpace Y, Nonempty Y and PolishSpace Y is flagged inline as FORBIDDEN x2 and UNKNOWN INSTANCE with FAILs on explicit sequence and total count; MISSING and ERROR lines both yield ABSENT from capture (fail closed) with a non-zero exit. This is evidence about the comparator, not about the R4 tree.

GRADE [S] Supervisor-reported, not re-run here: R4 full 82-module build and 9 exported-root axiom checks PASS; the R5 packets repair both SignatureEquivalence calls ('baseline_*_iff ... |>.mp happrox' replaced by happrox directly, exploiting defeq and removing the helper-captured Y instances), print both iff axioms, and FreshR5 adds 'open PlaneFiveColor.Spectral' for D/IsWild, giving 4+4 standard axiom prints with no sorry.

GRADE [C] RETAINED from block 14: the Baseline definitions are character-identical to the frozen originals after renaming, and both public theorem headers are identical after whitespace normalisation.

GRADE [R] Accepted evidence unchanged and explicitly bounded: preserved textual hypotheses + defeq + application compatibility. Exact binder identity is NOT claimed by the integration; this packet is supplementary inspection.
GRADE [R] Scope unchanged: certifying the supplied OpenAI proof gives chi(R^2) >= 6 as already stated, no new plane bound; chi(R^2) in {6,7} remains open.
conjectures: A real BinderAudit capture will most likely total 31 binders for each theorem with no forbidden instance; if it totals more, the extra binder is either an instance the sources do not show or an argument unrelated to the omit question, and the comparator will say which.

The four flagged Lean-side uncertainties (liftTermElabM, forallTelescopeReducing context, toString on MessageData, flat collapsing) are compile-level, so a failure there costs one edit, not a wrong audit.

A FAIL from this instrument should not be read as a defect without checking whether Lean discharged a binder by unification; the check is deliberately fail-closed, so it over-reports rather than under-reports.
